owner_boundary.summary: Lode declares checks; Core owns operation lifecycle and authorization; Harbor supplies refs-only page and effect evidence.

status_meaning.passed: The named action, external effect, operation ref, page/media readback and reconciliation agree with refs-only evidence.
status_meaning.failed: A required fact, ref, effect mapping, readback or no-out-of-scope invariant is missing or mismatched.
status_meaning.skipped: The static fixture cannot execute a live action; skipped is not a success claim.

result_contract.unknown_policy: accepted/running/unknown_outcome are preserved from Core; unknown external effect or reconciliation is never upgraded and never retried.
result_contract.submitted_policy: Save-draft and publish are outside this package; submitted remains false.

requirements.description: Verify exactly one action_id and requested_path pair: image_upload maps to upload; text_to_image_generate maps to generate/create.
requirements.on_failure: Return invalid_contract or operation_result_unknown; do not select another action or infer the effect.

requirements.description: Read Core-owned operation status as accepted, running, terminal, or unknown_outcome and preserve its operation ref without creating a second lifecycle.
requirements.on_failure: Return operation_result_unknown and expose the recovery entrypoint; never retry automatically.

requirements.description: Re-read refs-only page state plus upload count/order or generated result ref; no raw page or media bytes are accepted.
requirements.on_failure: Return post_check_failed or reconciliation_unknown and preserve unknown values.

requirements.description: Confirm save_draft, publish and submitted remain outside this package and no automatic retry or bypass occurred.
requirements.on_failure: Fail closed as invalid_contract; do not claim a safe media result.

fixture_post_check_output.reason: Static fixture does not execute upload or generation; live packaged evidence is deferred to WebEnvoy #409.

failure_boundary.login_required: No managed identity fact; return unavailable.
failure_boundary.permission_insufficient: Action control owner is not confirmed; do not execute.
failure_boundary.page_changed: Route or exact action control differs from the contract; stop.
failure_boundary.media_ref_unavailable: Owner ref is unavailable; do not substitute or retry.
failure_boundary.generation_unavailable: Required generation input/control is missing; preserve unknown.
failure_boundary.operation_result_unknown: Effect or operation terminal state is unclear; expose operation ref and recovery, no retry.
failure_boundary.post_check_failed: Required readback or refs are missing/mismatched.
failure_boundary.reconciliation_unknown: Operation exists but page state cannot be reconciled.

real_page_validation.reason: Static Lode fixture is not live evidence and cannot promote lifecycle.
required_later_runtime: Harbor/Core/App refs-only live evidence for both actions

non_goals: No browser execution or live post-check runner in Lode.
No save draft, publish, submit, retry, bypass, raw evidence, or second lifecycle.
